infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 114 in the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 114 key (Dorm 114) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the two-story dormitory with a tag reading "114" on it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Pharmacist

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first floor of the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Trading
